payload.text: A3, 2026-10-25: the dev/opt/brew contract's T4 drops ' at <root>' from the version line on hv's ruling (relayed by intent-ic and molt-vc; verbatim held by intent-vc): the line is <tool> <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty]), it names no path (command -v answers where), a compiled tool's provenance word sits directly after the parenthesis, and a reader reads up to the closing parenthesis and ignores the rest, so the old shape still reads and no reader carries two formats. Each tool ships it in its next release; devbin's is issue 0230, in 0.1.15. Not put to hv again.
